subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Escutar, com atenção, falas de professores e colegas, formulando perguntas pertinentes ao tema e solicitando esclarecimentos sempre que necessário.

components.description_pt: Ouvir atentamente os outros sem interrupções durante discussões em sala de aula
components.description_en: Listen attentively to others without interrupting during classroom discussions
components.cc_component_description: Listen attentively to others without interrupting during classroom discussions

components.description_pt: Fazer perguntas relevantes sobre o tema sendo discutido
components.description_en: Ask relevant questions about the topic being discussed
components.cc_component_description: Ask clarifying questions about topics and texts discussed with partners or adults

components.description_pt: Solicitar esclarecimento quando algo ouvido ou apresentado oralmente não é compreendido
components.description_en: Request clarification when something heard or presented orally is not understood
components.cc_component_description: Request clarification when something heard or presented orally is not understood

cc_matches.description: Follow agreed-upon rules for discussions (e.g., gaining the floor in respectful ways, listening to others with care, speaking one at a time about the topics and texts under discussion).

Confirm understanding of a text read aloud or information presented orally or through other media by asking and answering questions about key details and requesting clarification if something is not understood.
Participate in collaborative conversations with diverse partners about grade 2 topics and texts with peers and adults in small and larger groups.
